source_objects.description: Budget allocated to a position: funded amount, funding source (worktags: fund, cost center, grant), fiscal year. Equivalent to PS_POSITION_DATA budget fields + PS_POS_BUDGET.

Split funding across multiple sources. A single position may be 50% operating fund, 30% grant A, 20% grant B.

Position Funding where percentage is highest

notes: Position budgeting in higher ed often involves split funding — a single faculty position might be funded 60% by the department operating budget, 30% by a federal research grant, and 10% by a state training grant. When grants end, funding shifts ('backfill') are a common and complex process. Workday's costing allocation rules handle this, but the HELIX Bridge captures the resulting funding distribution for analytics.
